passage.text: Being online is fun and useful, but it can be dangerous, too.
passage.reading: ˈbiːɪŋ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ɪz ˈfʌn ənd ˈjuːsfəl, bʌt ɪt kən bi ˈdeɪndʒərəs, ˈtuː.

passage.text: Here is some advice from the university computer center.
passage.reading: ˈhɪr ɪz sʌm ədˈvaɪs frəm ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti kəmˈpjuːtər ˌsɛntər.

passage.text: Don't open emails or messages from strangers.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈoʊpən ˈiːmeɪlz ɔːr ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz frəm ˈstreɪndʒərz.

passage.text: Some messages have a virus, and it can delete your photos.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ˈhæv ə ˈvaɪrəs, ənd ɪt kən dɪˈliːt jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊz.

passage.text: Keep your profile private, so only your friends can see your photos.
passage.reading: ˈkiːp jʊr ˈproʊfaɪl ˈpraɪvət, soʊ ˈoʊnli jʊr ˈfrɛndz kən ˈsiː jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊz.

passage.text: Don't post your address or your phone number online.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈpoʊst jʊr ˈædrɛs ɔːr jʊr ˈfoʊn ˌnʌmbər ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

passage.text: Is anything wrong with your computer?
passage.reading: ɪz ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈrɔːŋ wɪð jʊr kəmˈpjuːtər?

passage.text: Come to the computer center in the library, and we'll help you.
passage.reading: ˈkʌm tə ðə kəmˈpjuːtər ˌsɛntər ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri, ənd wiːl ˈhɛlp juː.
